issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor: the problem statement UML declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning double, but the reference implementation defines public int getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). This return-type mismatch between the specification (problem_statement.md) and the solution (Lecture.java) will confuse students about the expected return type and may cause compilation or test failures if tests or grading infrastructure expect a double. The template file currently only has a TODO for this method and does not provide a signature.
